data.one_liner: Calculate the distance between two latitude and longitude coordinates
data.what_it_does: A Dart package that computes the geographic distance between two location coordinates using the Haversine formula. It supports multiple distance units including kilometers, meters, miles, and nautical miles.
use_when: You need to calculate distances between coordinates without relying on external mapping SDKs
You want simple distance calculations in kilometers, meters, miles, or nautical miles
avoid_when: You need full map rendering or geolocation tracking
You require route optimization or turn-by-turn navigation
weaknesses: Does not include built-in mapping widgets or location tracking

alternatives.name: geolocator
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you need device geolocation services, permissions, and built-in distance calculation functions.

alternatives.name: latlong2
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you are already using flutter_map and need geospatial calculations along with map rendering.
